reportOnlyUntil: no apply is authorized. This list is a VERIFIED SAMPLE of a class estimated at 180,000-320,000 rows -- far past the size a list can carry. It exists to prove the shape and the destination arithmetic; the class itself needs the LANE described in laneProposal, and that lane needs a ruling because the rematch IMPROVE predicate forbids a changed axis.
finding: A vintage sale is filed under the year it SOLD, not the year the card was issued. In a partition-bounded sample of 1,200 rows per slug year over 2015-2026, 4,616 of 5,939 in-scope slugs (77.7%) carry a title whose first stated year is pre-1990 while the slug year segment is 2015 or later. Every hit is source tca-ebay. Examples: 1951 Bowman #253 Mickey Mantle Rookie filed at hiq:baseball:2015:bowman:253:base:no-auto, and 1953 Topps #82 Mickey Mantle filed at hiq:baseball:2015:topps:82:base:no-auto. The pools are real and the cards are real; only the year segment is wrong, and it is wrong in a way that splits every vintage card across as many pools as it has sale years.
rulings: CF-THE-SLUG-YEAR-IS-THE-CARDS-YEAR-NOT-THE-SALES. The year segment names the issue the card belongs to. A 1951 Bowman Mantle that sold in 2015 is a 1951 card; filing it at :2015: splits its pool by sale year and prices it against nothing.

THIS IS NOT THE RETRO CASE, AND THE FILTER PROVES IT. A 2023 Topps Heritage card homaging a 1954 design states 1954 in its title and IS a 2023 card. Every such product is excluded by setKey (heritage, archives, tribute, gallery, allen-ginter, gypsy-queen, big-league, topps-now) and by title word (Heritage, Archives, Tribute, Reprint, Relic, Design, Anniversary, Retro, Buyback, Commemorative). 27 rows were excluded this way in the sample; what remains states a vintage year with no homage marker anywhere.

THE DESTINATION IS THE SAME CARD AT THE RIGHT YEAR. Only the year segment moves; sport, setKey, cardNumber, parallel and auto are carried verbatim, so no identity is invented and the destination is one the grammar already spells.

A COLLISION IS THE POINT, NOT THE PROBLEM (one card, one row, one pool). 154 of 160 point-read destinations (96.3%) already hold sales. The relocation MERGES a split pool rather than creating one; an empty destination is the exception and is where the caution lies.

AN UNBACKED DESTINATION IS A PARK (CF-CATALOG-MATCH-IS-SELF-CONFIRMING). 44 of 160 destinations returned no checklist-backed card_catalog row. Those rows stay exactly where they are and are marked identityUnverified -- relocating onto them would mint an identity whose only evidence is the sale.

census.method: read-only, partition-bounded: SELECT TOP 1200 ... WHERE c.cardYear=@y ORDER BY c.soldAt (the soldAt composite index makes this a seek), one query per slug year 2015-2026; then a card_catalog POINT READ per destination (card_catalog partitions on /cardId) and a partition-bounded COUNT on the destination pool.
census.classSizeEstimate: 180,000-320,000 rows. Measured hit rates against the tca-ebay population at five slug years (2015: 9.3% of 16,976; 2017: 58.8% of 21,924; 2019: 56.1% of 42,842; 2021: 48.2% of 76,215; 2024: 44.5% of 232,946) give ~178,848 rows for those five years alone.
census.vintageVocabularySource: derived, not guessed: the setKey segment of slugs whose year segment is genuinely pre-1990, sampled at ten vintage years in sold_comps (3,000 slugs, 23 distinct setKeys) -- topps, bowman, fleer, kelloggs, donruss, upper-deck, score, o-pee-chee, topps-traded, fleer-stickers, leaf, star, panini-donruss, fleer-update.

laneProposal.why: At 180k-320k rows this is a LANE, not a list. A relocation list caps at what can be point-read; this class is three orders of magnitude larger.
laneProposal.lane: the GREAT REMATCH, as a new subclass -- 'changed:cardYear from the title when the slug year is a sale year'.
laneProposal.blocker: The rematch IMPROVE predicate forbids a CHANGED axis, and this moves cardYear. It therefore needs a RULING before it can be armed, exactly as base-eviction did.
laneProposal.rulingQuestion: May the rematch treat changed:cardYear as APPLICABLE when the title states a pre-1990 year, the slug year is >= 2015, the setKey is vintage-capable, and the product is not a retro/homage issue?
proposedGuard: setKey in the vintage-capable vocabulary derived from the corpus

product NOT retro: no heritage/archives/tribute/gallery/allen-ginter/gypsy-queen/big-league/topps-now setKey and no Heritage/Archives/Tribute/Reprint/Relic/Design/Anniversary/Retro/Buyback/Commemorative title token
destination card_catalog row is checklist-backed, else PARK
laneProposal.expectedOutcome: ~96% of relocations merge into an existing pool at the destination; the remainder create a pool at a checklist-backed address. Rows failing the checklist gate are parked identityUnverified, never moved.

provenance.writes: none -- no Cosmos writes, no runner dispatches
